title: GMI theme-graph node row v1
description: One ROW of data/theme_graph/nodes.parquet, as a JSON object. The parquet store is the artifact; this schema is the row contract producers emit against and the guard (scripts/check_theme_graph_contracts.py) validates samples against. Masterplan §4.1. Node identity is PERMANENT: a company node id never re-points at a different company — a reused ticker mints a new node at identity_epoch+1 and retires the old one (reused-ticker zombie law; config/theme_graph_identity_breaks.yml is the sole source of epochs). Additive-only for v1: a later wave may add columns, never rename or repurpose one.

node_id.description: Stable slug, unique per row. Company nodes are 'co:<market>:<SYMBOL>' with an optional '#<epoch>' suffix from epoch 2 on; themes 'theme:<id>'; baskets 'basket:<suite>:<basket_id>'; ETFs 'etf:<SYMBOL>'.

name_en.description: English display name, or null. G0.9: a node with no SAME_AS/EXPRESSES edge into an existing vocabulary carries no user-visible name — the join key is not a name.

name_zh.description: 中文 display name, or null.

market_scope.description: us | cn | hk | ca | intl | global — the market the node lives in, lower-case.

tier.description: macro_category | theme | micro_theme for theme nodes; null elsewhere.

merged_into.description: Target node_id when status=merged. Dead themes and dead members are RETAINED (theme-level survivorship + the gap-refusal survivorship law) — a node never disappears, it changes status.

identity_epoch.description: 1 for every node minted without a ratified identity break. Any value >=2 REQUIRES a matching row in config/theme_graph_identity_breaks.yml (guard-enforced).

external_ids.description: JSON-encoded object of vocabulary ids this node resolves to, e.g. {"foresight_id": "solar"} or {"ths_code": "301079"}. A JSON STRING rather than a nested column so the parquet stays flat and diffable.

provenance.description: Which artifact minted this node, e.g. 'membership_doc:baskets_china_ths' or 'crosswalk:config/theme_crosswalk.yml'.
